I didn’t just witness East Palo Alto’s history in the 90's —I lived it.
​
Raised right here in East Palo Alto, educated in our local schools, first-generation Tongan American, my roots in this city run deep. Over the years, I’ve lived on Hazelwood Way, Newell Court (West Park), O'Connor Street, and in The Village District. I graduated preschool from the Little Bluehouse in 1992, 8th grade from 49ers Academy, and attended Menlo Atherton with youth from The Mid-Town District. This community shaped who I am.
​
As a businesswoman holding degrees in Political Science and Business Management, I combine practical fiscal discipline with deep policy knowledge, and I bring independent, common-sense leadership to City Hall—putting the people's interest first, every single time.
​
My promise to EPA is simple: Get the basics right first.
​
Before we expand development, we must fix our aging water infrastructure and secure our flood defenses. We cannot build East Palo Alto’s future on deteriorating pipes.
​
Once our city's foundation is secure, I will fight to:
​
Prevent Displacement & Protect Housing: Keep local families and long-time residents in their homes.
Support Local Small Businesses: Keep wealth inside EPA by empowering our neighborhood entrepreneurs.
Calm Neighborhood Traffic: Make our streets safer for children, families, and seniors across all neighborhoods.
Invest in Youth & Parks: Expand safe, enriching recreational and educational opportunities for our next generation.
## Our Pillars
##### Affordable Housing
We are committed to expanding affordable housing options and protecting our community from displacement through equitable development policies.
##### Local Growth
We prioritize economic development that creates local jobs and ensures our businesses thrive while maintaining a strong community foundation.
##### Community Safety
Public safety isn't about politics—it's about protecting our kids, supporting our families, and ensuring every resident feels safe on their own street.
TAKE ACTION
## Power in Numbers
Join our mission to empower our community. Whether you're looking to volunteer your time or register to vote, your involvement is the most powerful way to shape the future of East Palo Alto.
##### Volunteer
Help us reach our community goals. Whether you're skilled or just looking to get involved, your time is a vital part of our campaign.
Get Involved
##### Register to Vote
Ensure your voice is heard. Register to vote today and help us build a more equitable East Palo Alto for everyone.
Register to Vote
